context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about civic engagement
purpose: Teach: 公募/補強/常任/衆院/本店/頂点/市立/乗車

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 市民活動への関わり方について、少しお話ししてもよろしいですか。
lines.en: May I share a few thoughts about how to engage with civic activities?
lines.style: Elder statesman offering measured, polite counsel to younger executive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろんです。実はこの前、市立図書館の運営委員を公募していると知って、応募しようか迷っていまして。
lines.en: Of course. Actually, I recently learned the city library is openly recruiting operating committee members, and I'm hesitating whether to apply.
lines.style: Younger executive speaking earnestly, slightly deferential to his senior.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それは良い兆候ですよ。本店の経営だけに籠っていては、社会感覚の補強にはなりませんからね。
lines.en: That's a healthy instinct. Cocooning yourself in head office management won't reinforce your sense of society.
lines.style: Reflective veteran tone, weaving gentle wisdom with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ただ、常任の委員になると毎週通うことになって、衆院議員の知り合いからは負担が大きいぞと言われました。
lines.en: But becoming a permanent committee member means going weekly, and an acquaintance who's a Lower House member warned me the burden is heavy.
lines.style: Cautious professional weighing practical constraints against ambition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 負担はあって当然。でも、業界の頂点を目指すなら、地域に根を張る経験は何より効きますよ。
lines.en: Of course there's a burden. But if you aim for the top of your industry, grounding yourself locally pays off more than anything.
lines.style: Sage mentor speaking plainly, with conviction earned from decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。週末は乗車券を買って、現場の声を聞きに回るような姿勢が必要ですね。
lines.en: I see. I'd need the attitude of buying a train ticket on weekends and going around listening to people on the ground.
lines.style: Younger man processing the advice aloud, growing convinced.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうそう。肩書を脱いで歩く時間が、結局は一番の勉強になるものです。
lines.en: Exactly. Time spent walking around without your title ends up being the greatest education.
lines.style: Warm, fatherly close — quiet smile audible in delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: わかりました。明日にでも公募の書類を取り寄せてみます。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll request the application papers as early as tomorrow. Thank you very much.
lines.style: Resolute, grateful conclusion from the younger executive.
